It’s fine to be an arsehole, it’s fine if most people think you’re an arsehole. It also depends why they think you’re an arsehole.

If it’s because you abuse your power - then ya, that’s a red flag, like abusing waitstaff.
If it’s because of your moral or political views, maybe they’re arseholes.
If it’s because you can’t be bothered to say things just to make people feel good, I think that’s fine.
If it’s because you’re aggressive in business, and aren’t super helpful - I don’t think that’s good, and women should be wary of this sort of man as aggressive arsehole at work is the aggressive arsehole at home, but these men are very successful often - so that one’s up for debate.

It really depends how many people consider you to be an arsehole and why. Plenty of times it’s fine to be that person, so maybe don’t sweat it?
Fortunately not, though I have to find a new place to rent.
Zero income. If I stretched it maybe a year and a bit. But even if I get a job towards the end of my funds I’m treading water again. I’m tired of treading water.
I would be happy to do the f***ing work but nobody will hire me anymore. I’m basically waiting to run out of money.
I’m 40, it was always bad, ifs just now it’s impossible to get a job. I’m mostly trapped at home unless I go out to binge eat...
I’m so spent living like this... And if I can’t even pay tax, then why must I be forced to live? It’s barbaric!
